skills.name: product-value-fab
skills.summary: Turns a PRD, spec or feature list into a Feature–Advantage–Benefit analysis grounded in your audience, their pain points and the competition.

skills.name: positioning-messaging
skills.summary: Writes a positioning statement and messaging house from product docs, personas and competitor research, then drafts taglines and pitches.

skills.name: user-persona-builder
skills.summary: Builds evidence-based personas and JTBD statements from interviews, surveys, reviews and CRM notes, with every trait traced to evidence.

skills.name: customer-review-mining
skills.summary: Mines G2, App Store, Reddit, NPS and support feedback into ranked pain points, outcomes and objections, in customers' own words.

skills.name: competitive-market-research
skills.summary: Builds competitor profiles, sales battlecards, market maps and pricing teardowns, with every source graded by how much to trust it.

skills.name: feature-launch-kit
skills.summary: Turns a PRD or changelog into release notes, a customer announcement, sales one-pager, support FAQ and social posts that all agree on the facts.

skills.name: customer-case-study
skills.summary: Turns an interview transcript or CSM notes into a result-led case study with real quotes, plus short versions for sales decks and social.

skills.name: ai-product-audit
skills.summary: Audits an AI feature for transparency, dark patterns, overreliance, privacy, safety and compliance risk, with evidence and a fix for each issue.

skills.name: research-question-grill
skills.summary: Interviews you one question at a time until a vague topic becomes a focused, answerable research question with scope, concepts and a falsifier.

skills.name: sociology-deep-research
skills.summary: Builds a citation-checked literature review and research dossier on a social question, with claim–evidence tables and an adversarial critique.

skills.name: interview-guide
skills.summary: Designs a semi-structured interview guide with themed open questions, probes, consent points and a bias check.

skills.name: thematic-analysis
skills.summary: Runs reflexive thematic analysis on transcripts: a codebook with located quotes, reviewed themes and a write-up with an audit trail.

skills.name: quantitative-analysis
skills.summary: Plans, runs and writes up survey or social science statistics, with assumption checks and interpretation that doesn't overclaim causation.

skills.name: content-research-analyst
skills.summary: Turns articles, reports and news into a source-traceable research brief before you write a post, newsletter or report.

skills.name: fact-check-draft
skills.summary: Checks a draft sentence by sentence against its sources and flags unsupported, overclaimed, wrong and outdated claims, then fixes them.
